memory_candidates.content: chapter-quality-check.sh Rule 1.2 resolves backticked paths against repo root and the chapter's own directory only -- it does not know about FormalSystem/ as a Lean module root, so any chapter citing a Lean file path without the FormalSystem/ prefix (e.g. `Syntax/Formula.lean` instead of `FormalSystem/Syntax/Formula.lean`) fails Rule 1.2 even though the declaration name is correct.

template.typ's #leansrc(module, name) macro (dotted module path + declaration name) does not trigger chapter-quality-check.sh's backtick-path rule at all, since it is not a backtick-delimited path token -- using it as the default Lean-declaration citation form avoids the path-prefix pitfall entirely rather than requiring a prefix fix.
